scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and deterministic checks supplied. Originality may be implicit in broader constrained linear-response theory. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed harmonic trap and propulsion, symmetric stationary initial data, independent telegraph tumbles, positive baseline flip rate, measurable bounded extra flip-rate and fixed duration. Globally optimal at first order in intervention strength; not a finite-amplitude or full-distribution theorem.
title: Sharp activity-dose placement for variance suppression in a harmonically trapped run-and-tumble particle
